description: This file defines types, function prototypes, and API functions related to pattern parsing and evaluation in the lighttpd server. It includes definitions for 'liPattern', callback types, and functions for creating, freeing, and evaluating patterns.

methods.name: li_pattern_new
methods.description: Constructs a new liPattern structure by parsing the specified string; returns NULL if parsing fails.

methods.name: li_pattern_free
methods.description: Frees the memory allocated for a given liPattern instance.

methods.name: li_pattern_eval
methods.description: Evaluates a pattern in the context of a virtual request, appending the result to the provided GString. Supports callbacks for placeholder substitution.

methods.name: li_pattern_array_cb
methods.description: Default callback for array elements containing GString* objects.

methods.name: li_pattern_regex_cb
methods.description: Default callback for regex match info objects.

ctags.name: liPatternCB
ctags.pattern: /^typedef void (*liPatternCB) (GString *pattern_result, guint from, guint to, gpointer data);$/
